title: Udhte hue ufano mein

lines.text: Aane wale kal mein bhi hoga
Aane wale kal mein bhi hoga
Mujh par tera bas na chal saka

chords:
[Verse 1]
Udhte hue ufano mein,
Tu hi mera chattan
Behti hui lahero pe
Tere kadmo ke nishan

[CHORUS]
Bhavar ke bich mein
Tu kehta hai thamja
Tu meri taakat hai
Tu hi mera eeman
...repeat

[Verse 2]
Beete kal mein tu,
Saath mere tha
Aaj bhi mere
Saath hai khada
Aane wale kal mein bhi hoga

[Bridge 1]
Udhte hue ufano mein........

[Verse 3]
Bimariyon mein,
Tu kehta hai uthja
Yehova Rafa
Tu hi mera shifa
...repeat

[Bridge 2]
Beete kal mein tu,
Saath mere tha
Aaj bhi mere
Saath hai khada
Aane wale kal mein bhi hoga

[Bridge 3]
Udhte hue ufano mein........

[Verse 4]
Bimari, dekh tera sar jhuka
Mujh par tera bas na chal saka
Aisa koi shastra na bana
Jo kar sakega mera samna

[Outro]
Udhte hue ufano mein........
